title: Source Maps
body:
A separate file (`.map`) generated at build time that maps positions in shipped, minified, transpiled output back to positions in your original source. DevTools reads it and shows you your real files, real variable names, and real line numbers instead of a single 400KB line of mangled code.

They exist because everything you ship has been through [[Minification]] and [[Transpiling]], so the code running in the user's browser barely resembles what you wrote. The map is produced on a build machine and consumed by DevTools on your machine. Worth knowing that publishing source maps publicly exposes your original source, which is why many teams upload them to an error-tracking service instead of serving them to end users. See [[Call Stack]].
